items.description: Item results aligned to the prepared batch payload order.

BoundaryProbabilityMicrosV2.description:
Fixed-point probability in the inclusive unit interval at micro precision.

The private field and fallible deserializer prevent invalid probabilities
from crossing the worker boundary as ordinary integers.

HubCommitV2.description: An exact hub commit: 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

oneOf.description: Preserve current behavior: suppress the earlier adjacent non-ordinary action.
Experimental replay: suppress only the earlier of adjacent true boundaries.

UtsegBoundaryActionV2.description:
Closed label vocabulary emitted by the TalkBank utterance-boundary model.

Names describe model semantics instead of exposing classifier label indices,
whose numeric ordering is an implementation detail of the Python model.

oneOf.description: Ordinary lexical word with no punctuation or onset label.
Capitalized word classified as an utterance onset.

UtsegBoundaryModelEvidenceV2.description:
Provenance-bearing evidence emitted by one boundary-model invocation.

The wrapper prevents a per-word evidence vector from traveling without the
model identity needed to interpret or reproduce it.

model_id.description: HuggingFace model identifier the control plane pinned.

model_revision.description:
The exact revision the worker loaded, and never anything else.

Required, and a [`HubCommitV2`] rather than a string: the boundary model
is resolved from a pinned snapshot whose commit is read off the
directory on disk, so a worker that cannot say which revision it loaded
refuses instead of reporting one. It was `Option<String>` while the
model loaded by NAME and the revision was scraped from
`config._commit_hash`, which could simply be absent; nothing downstream
could distinguish "no revision" from "a revision nobody recorded".

normalization_revision.description: Exact lexical-normalization semantics applied before inference.

word_evidence.description: Evidence states parallel to the request word list.

UtsegItemResultV2.description: One utseg item result returned by Python.

assignments.description: Direct word-group assignments when inference succeeded without raw trees.

boundary_model_evidence.description: Provenance-bearing classifier evidence parallel to the request words.

trees.description: Raw constituency trees when inference succeeded.

UtsegNormalizationRevisionV2.description: Closed lexical-normalization semantics applied before model inference.

oneOf.description: Lowercase, trim, and remove ASCII period/question/exclamation/comma.

UtsegWordBoundaryEvidenceV2.description:
Evidence state for one input word, parallel to the request word list.

A normalization omission is a first-class variant, so consumers never
confuse "the model classified this as ordinary" with "the model never saw
this word". List position owns word identity; there is no redundant index
that could disagree with it.

oneOf.description: The normalized word reached the classifier.

applied_action.description: Decision after adjacency policy, used to build assignments.

boundary_probability_micros.description: Sum of the model probabilities for the three true boundary labels.

raw_action.description: Raw classifier decision before adjacency policy.

oneOf.description: Normalization removed the word before classifier inference.
The normalized input was too short for classifier inference.
